clips.title: The story
paras: Forsaken assaults falter at Dead Field, a ruined farmstead in northern Silverpine Forest. Rot Hide gnolls serve the Scourge there, while the banshee Nightlash turns back those who attack.

The ruined farmstead lies in northern Silverpine Forest, its human occupants lost to the Third War. Rot Hide gnolls now use the plot as a base and willingly serve the Scourge. Deathstalker scouts passing through the region have noted signs of imminent military mobilization that threatens Forsaken supply lines and outposts. Small Forsaken assaults on the farm have repeatedly failed. Each time the gnolls are endangered, Nightlash, a wailing banshee, appears and drives the attackers back.
